spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Nook is a comprehensive three-sided acoustic
workstation enclosure designed to create an intimate, distraction-free booth
around individual desks. Wrapping the back and both sides of a workstation, Nook
delivers an outstanding sound absorption rating of 1.55 Sabins per unit to
shield workers from peripheral noise and visual motion. Fixed non-destructively
with Vicinity Clamps, it is formed from 100% polyester fibre with an 80%
recycled PET core and meets Group 1 fire safety standards.

install:
Unpack the 3-piece Nook
screen set and verify all components

Attach Vicinity Desk Clamps to
pre-routed sockets on rear and side panels

Align the three panels around the
back and both sides of the desktop

Tighten the clamp mounting bolts from
underneath the desk using an Allen key

Ensure all corners fit neatly and the
enclosure stands rigidly around the workspace
selection_checklist:
Select size matching desk width (Nook 1600 for 1600mm desks; Nook 1800
for 1800mm desks)

Confirm desktop depth and edge overhang allow clamp
installation on three sides
Select colour from the Autex Cube palette
Confirm pack quantity (supplied in packs of 4 complete screens)

Verify that
side return wings do not impede user movement or drawer pedestals
limitations: Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct liquid contact

Workstation desk
must accommodate side and rear clamps

Sold in pack quantities of 4 complete
screens

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Nook is a 3-piece, three-sided
wrap-around acoustic desk enclosure formed from 12mm Cube polyester felt to
cocoon 1600mm or 1800mm workstations. Absorbing an impressive 1.55 Sabins per
unit across rear and dual-side panels, it blocks peripheral vision and
conversational noise to establish an intimate focus booth in busy open-plan
spaces. Mounted non-destructively via 100% recycled PET Vicinity Clamps and
compliant with Group 1 fire standards, Nook delivers maximum personal acoustic
privacy.
